Body.Content:
Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting. When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for signs of possible social engineering. If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.

GA date: November CY2027
